listing.summary: The project’s stage 5 report shows the initial con.exe build about 15% complete. First startup remains planned; no playable build is established. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-20565 disc. The player README also requires BIOS and IRX files supplied by you; this guide does not establish an exact BIOS version.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the Windows 10/11 x64 source route with local Python generation, MSVC2022 C++ and CMake. This guide does not identify a completed release.
